## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: towing with a Class C license
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The towing chapter is general information; the handbook points to a separate study guide for J endorsement and larger non-commercial classes, which was not consulted [A01].
The right-turn figures are referenced by number only; the written rules were taught without describing the figures [A04].
The rearward amplification chart lists rig types with values that did not extract cleanly; only the two values stated in the body text were taught [A06].
The jackknife diagrams carry captions only; the procedure was taught from the body text [A07].
Several items in the chapter, such as triple trailers, describe commercial rigs for context; they are taught only as the handbook explains them and not as Class C permissions.

corpus_stability.reason: The Nevada Driver's Handbook carries one edition line on its cover (DMV 700 March 2024) and one copyright year on its title page, with a short key-changes list; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year. The edition is about two and a half years old at intake, so currency is held as freshness debt in part A.
